priorStories.headline: Oil tankers attacked near Strait of Hormuz
priorStories.body: At least three oil tankers were attacked near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, according to the Associated Press. UK maritime authorities reported two separate projectile strikes early that morning, with no casualties reported in those incidents.

candidates.summary: At COP31 in Antalya, Sweden's chief negotiator Mattias de Frumerie told SVT that the EU could not accept the proposed overarching decision, citing its omission of fossil fuels and emphasis on carbon capture. Germany also said it would not support the current draft. The scheduled closing plenary was delayed, and negotiations remained unresolved.
candidates.title: European negotiators oppose proposed COP31 closing text

candidates.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah departed Kathmandu for a two-day state visit to India at Narendra Modi's invitation. Radio Nepal reported his departure at 2:05 p.m. Nepal time, equivalent to 08:20 UTC. His delegation included the finance and foreign ministers. Bilateral talks and proposed agreements remained pending.
candidates.title: Nepal's prime minister departs for state visit to India

candidates.summary: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, taking his third victory at the event. Norris finished 0.639 seconds behind. George Russell dropped to ninth after hitting the barriers late in the race, while Kimi Antonelli finished fourth. The race took place Saturday evening in Nevada and concluded early Sunday on the New York calendar.
candidates.title: Verstappen wins Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of McLaren pair

candidates.summary: COP31's closing plenary in Antalya ended without consensus on an overarching climate agreement. Conference president Murat Kurum said the proposed decisions had not been adopted after the European Union and other delegations opposed the final draft. Disagreements included fossil-fuel transition language, carbon capture and financial support for developing countries. The outcome supersedes the earlier report that negotiations remained unresolved.
candidates.title: COP31 closes without consensus on overarching climate agreement

candidates.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi and met Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar at the Taj Mahal Hotel on Sunday evening. Nepal's foreign ministry spokesperson said discussions covered connectivity, trade, transit, energy, culture, education and people-to-people ties. Shah's meetings with Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu remained scheduled for November 23; no completed bilateral agreements were reported in the meeting accounts.
candidates.title: Nepal's prime minister meets Jaishankar after arriving in India

sources.name: Press Information Bureau, Government of India

candidates.summary: Ukrainian officials reported at least four deaths following Russian drone attacks in the Kyiv region on Sunday. Three bodies were recovered from a damaged five-story apartment building in Dymer, where about ten people might still have been trapped, Reuters reported. A later strike on a grocery store in Vyshneve killed one person and injured three, according to the regional governor. Rescuers in Dymer suspended their search at 13:35 UTC because of another aerial threat.
candidates.title: Officials report four deaths in Kyiv-region drone attacks as rescue search continues
candidates.geography: Dymer and Vyshneve, Kyiv region, Ukraine

candidates.summary: Libya's eastern-based government said Sunday that preliminary findings indicated a suspected drone attack caused an explosion aboard a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base. Authorities said the vessel had stopped for fuel and supplies and that a joint investigation with Russia had begun. Reuters cited two medical sources reporting injuries but no deaths; the number and nationalities of those injured were unclear. No group had claimed responsibility. The vessel's identity and reported destruction were not established by these accounts.
candidates.title: Eastern Libyan authorities report suspected drone attack on Russian ship
